Name: Book Collecting (SNF)
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Search for fun little books hidden around the valley! Adds 70 (non-power) books to collect, book genre tags, genre-based book gift responses for vanilla NPCs, a Book Fair, and support for other mods to add additional books.

These are [b]not[/b] power books. Instead, they're just regular books - novels, guides, magazines etc - created using secret note mechanics and hidden around the valley for fun. Each book has a short written excerpt, and once read, will show up in your secret notes page.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] are required dependencies for this mod to work.

To start collecting these books, you will need to have obtained the [b]Magnifying Glass[/b]. This mod can be added to preexisting saves. Note that it might take a day or two for the books to start showing up once you obtain those powers or add this mod to your save.

Once you have those, you can start looking for books by interacting with map tiles (be sure to look around bookshelves!) and checking various shops. Some books may only appear after certain conditions have been met. When you find a book, read it like you would any other secret note. If you would ever like to re-read a book, you can click on it in your secret notes page.

Books that you have read will show up in the Booksellers shop, as well as a few other shops around town. Those books can then be gifted to NPCs; vanilla NPCs have custom book gift tastes and dialogue based on the genre of the book!

Once you've read 15 books, you'll unlock a new passive festival called the Book Fair that takes place on Spring 9 in Pelican Town, where you can buy various books (the number of books available for sale will increase as you find more books).

[b]Compatibilities[/b]
Stardew Valley Expanded: compatible!
Other expansions (RSV, ES, VMV, PC etc): should be compatible but let me know if you find any issues.
Other book mods: should be compatible but let me know if you find any issues.
Less Ugly Town Interiors: compatible!
Multiplayer: I tried to set this up to work in multiplayer, but I haven't been able to test it with that, so let me know if you find any issues and I'll see what I can do.

[b]Mod Authors
[/b]This mod supports other mods adding their own book packs, as well as modders giving their own NPCs book-related gift tastes and dialogue, and even letting their NPCs attend the Book Fair! See the Articles tab for a guide and some tips if you're interested :)
There's also a template under Optional Files to make it easy to add books, and I've added helpful comments to some of my mod files if you'd like to look in there and see what I did directly.

[b]Translations
[/b]No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Art Replacements
[/b]No AI art please. If you'd like to make and publish your own version of any of the art I created for this mod, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab with a link to your SMAPI log. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: smapi.io/log
